in_sanskrit.name: अर्जुनाथ
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is valiant, invincible, and is the support of the people. Arjuna is a well-known bearer of this name.

in_marathi.name: Arjnath
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Brave, Arrow, Warrior
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arjnath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Arjnath is a Sanskrit name, derived from the Sanskrit word 'arjuna' which means 'unconquered'. In Hindu mythology, Arjuna is the name of a great warrior, one of the five Pandava brothers, and the principal character in the Mahabharata. This name is often given to boys to signify bravery and strength.
